title: Carrier Wave
style: Instrumental melodic trance and bright arcade synth-pop at 160 BPM in A major. A clear bell-like arpeggiator carries a rising six-note signal motif, answered by bowed synth strings and octave bass. Crisp four-on-the-floor drums, gentle off-beat hats, high airy pads and a wide polar-night stereo field. Full rhythm from the opening, soaring middle eight, cycling hook suitable for continuous gameplay. Instrumental only, no vocals or spoken words.
